chunks.head: go after
chunks.note: go after sb/sth = 去追、追赶;也指'追求(目标)'。
chunks.ex_en: The dog went after the cat.

chunks.head: make fun of
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(make a world of fun of him),故 card-only。make fun of sb = 取笑某人。
chunks.ex_en: The kids made fun of his big hat.
chunks.ex_cn: 孩子们取笑他那顶大帽子。

chunks.head: give up
chunks.note: give up (doing) sth = 放弃;此处'放弃了买通那帮孩子的念头'。

literal.note_cn: 非'向上'义,与 give 合成'放弃'

chunks.ex_en: Don't give up—you can do it!

chunks.head: pay attention to
chunks.note: 本章出处为 paid no attention to(否定分离式),故 card-only。pay attention to sth = 注意某事。
chunks.ex_en: Pay attention to the teacher.

chunks.head: stick to
chunks.note: stick to sth = 坚持不放;此处'专心干自己的活'。

literal.note_cn: 非'粘贴'义,引申为'守着不放'

chunks.ex_en: Stick to your plan and finish it.
chunks.ex_cn: 坚持你的计划,把它做完。

chunks.head: one's mouth waters
chunks.note: one's mouth waters = 看到想要的东西而馋得流口水。

literal.note_cn: 非'浇水'义,此处作动词'流口水'

chunks.ex_en: My mouth waters when I smell fresh bread.
chunks.ex_cn: 闻到新鲜面包我就直流口水。

chunks.head: let on
chunks.gloss: 假装、佯装;(次义)走漏口风、说出去
chunks.note: let on = 假装(佯装喜欢/不知道/不在乎);次义'走漏口风、说出去'。此处「let on that you like it」=装作你喜欢(汤姆假装享受刷墙)。on 非'在…上'。

literal.note_cn: 整体记忆;on 非'在…上'义

chunks.ex_en: He let on that he liked the boring job.
chunks.ex_cn: 他装作喜欢这份无聊的活儿。

chunks.head: in a new light
chunks.gloss: 以新的眼光(看)、呈现新面貌
chunks.note: see/put sth in a new light = 从新的角度去看。
chunks.ex_en: Her words made me see the problem in a new light.
chunks.ex_cn: 她的话让我用新的眼光看这个问题。

chunks.head: back and forth
chunks.note: move back and forth = 来来回回。
chunks.ex_en: The swing moved back and forth.

chunks.head: here and there
chunks.note: here and there = 零零散散到处都是。
chunks.ex_en: Toys were scattered here and there.

chunks.head: be particular about
chunks.note: be particular about sth = 对某事很讲究、很挑剔。

literal.note_cn: 非'特定的'义,此处指'苛求'

chunks.ex_en: She is very particular about her food.

chunks.head: no lack of
chunks.note: there is no lack of sth = 一点也不缺某物。
chunks.ex_en: We had no lack of volunteers.

chunks.head: and so on
chunks.note: 列举之后收尾 = 等等。
chunks.ex_en: I bought apples, bananas, and so on.

chunks.head: all the while
chunks.note: all the while = 自始至终、一直。
chunks.ex_en: She smiled all the while.

chunks.head: run out of
chunks.note: run out of sth = 把某物用光。

literal.note_cn: 非'跑'义,与 out 合成'耗尽'

chunks.ex_en: We ran out of milk this morning.
chunks.ex_cn: 今早我们的牛奶用完了。

chunks.head: after all
chunks.note: after all = 毕竟(补充理由或与预期相反)。
chunks.ex_en: It worked out fine after all.

chunks.head: in order to
chunks.note: in order to do sth = 为了做某事(表目的)。
chunks.ex_en: She got up early in order to catch the train.

chunks.head: be obliged to
chunks.note: be obliged to do = 被迫/有义务去做。
chunks.ex_en: We are obliged to follow the rules.

chunks.head: consist of
chunks.note: consist of = 由…构成(不用被动)。
chunks.ex_en: The team consists of five players.
chunks.ex_cn: 这个队由五名队员组成。

chunks.head: turn into
chunks.note: 本章出处为 turn it into(分离式),故 card-only。turn (sth) into = 变成。
chunks.ex_en: The rain turned into snow.

chunks.head: take place
chunks.note: take place = (事件)发生、举办(多指有安排的)。
chunks.ex_en: The meeting will take place on Monday.

chunks.head: too much for sb
chunks.gloss: 让某人招架不住、受不了
chunks.note: be too much for sb = 让某人吃不消、抵挡不住。
chunks.ex_en: The hot weather was too much for the old dog.
chunks.ex_cn: 炎热的天气让那只老狗受不了。

chunks.head: alter one's mind
chunks.note: alter/change one's mind = 改变主意;change one's mind 更常用。
chunks.ex_en: He changed his mind at the last minute.
chunks.ex_cn: 他在最后一刻改变了主意。
